name: Constellation Crawler Orrery
introDiscord: A drowned orrery turns above the reef floor, its enormous rings still mapping constellations after centuries underwater. Tiny Constellation Crawlers scamper across the machinery, physically moving stars whenever they dislike the arrangement.
introTwitch: A drowned orrery turns above the reef floor, its enormous rings still mapping constellations after centuries underwater. Tiny Constellation Crawlers scamper across the machinery, physically moving stars whenever they dislike the arrangement.

orbit-gate.prompt: The orrery's outer ring turns around three moving approaches. Glowing stars roll along its tracks while tiny Crawlers drag constellations into personally improved positions.

left.message: Shizuki's Zodiac tonic reads: "The stars suggested patience. I chose a shortcut. Stars remain judgmental."
left.fullHpMessage: The Zodiac tonic remains untouched. You are already at full health, and the stars may practice patience instead.

right.message: A Crawler drags one glowing star across the floor, realizes you're standing where it wants the star, and treats this as your problem.

forward.message: A Moonkeeper cache rotates past once every thirty seconds. You time the mechanism, step aboard, and retrieve Star Candies before it carries the cache away again.

starwheel-chamber.prompt: A massive starwheel turns overhead. Three exits align and separate with each rotation while Crawlers ride the moving rings like tiny celestial maintenance workers.

left.message: A moon-shell coffer is attached to one rotating spoke. After completing an unnecessary full orbit, you finally reach it and collect Star Candies.

right.message: Shizuki's remedy reads: "Drink when destiny becomes overly specific. Especially if destiny says 'wait here.'"
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's anti-destiny remedy remains sealed. At full health, you have no reason to wait here just because fate suggested it.

forward.message: A Crawler changes three stars, watches an entire exit rotate away, then looks extremely pleased with itself. You were using that exit.

celestial-track.prompt: Glowing constellations race along three moving tracks. Each route appears only when the correct stars align—and the Crawlers keep changing them.

left.message: A Crawler steals the glowing marker that was guiding your route and scampers away with it. Catching it becomes less optional when it turns and attacks.

right.message: A Fae vessel rides the celestial track beneath a tiny constellation shaped like a spoon. You have questions, but Star Candies are a sufficient distraction.

forward.message: One Berry rests on Shizuki's chart beside 'Possible Exit.' The word 'Fate' has been crossed out and replaced with 'WE'LL SEE.'

boss-antechamber.name: Weaver Meridian
boss-antechamber.prompt: All of the orrery's moving tracks converge at one brilliant meridian. Half-woven constellations hang above a central mechanism large enough to rearrange the sky.

bossPromptDiscord:
The entire orrery stops.

Every Crawler freezes.

Then the constellations begin moving without their help.

At the center, something enormous is weaving the stars into a new pattern.

Use /yes to enter the Meridian or /no to leave destiny unsupervised.
bossPromptTwitch:
The entire orrery stops.

Every Crawler freezes.

Then the constellations begin moving without their help.

At the center, something enormous is weaving the stars into a new pattern.

Use !yes to enter the Meridian or !no to leave destiny unsupervised.
bossRetreatText: You leave Weaver Meridian unsupervised. The constellations continue rearranging themselves while every Crawler watches in offended silence.

boss.revealText: The constellations knot together as a vast Crawler descends through the stopped orrery. The Zodiac Weaver takes the Meridian!

completionText: The Zodiac Weaver releases the constellation, and the orrery starts turning normally again. The Crawlers immediately rush in to rearrange everything it just fixed.
